paite: Gilead mi Jephthah mihat hangsan ahi a, kizuaknu tapa ahi. Gilead in Jephthah asuang hi.
heading: Jephthah Sapkikna

paite: Gilead zi in tapate asuansak a; azi tapate ahong pichin un Jephthah adelhkhia ua, akiang ah, "Nang zaw ka pa uh inn ah gou na luah thei kei ding. Numei tuam khat tapa na hih ziak in," achi uhi.
Huchi in Jephthah a-unaute a pan ataimang a, Tob gam ah ateng hi. Jephthah kiang ah mithulim lou pipi atengkhawm ua, amah azui zel uh.
Huai nung deuh in Ammon suante'n Israelte adouta uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Ammon suante'n Israelte adou uleh, Gilead upate Tob gam a Jephthah pi ding in apaikheta uhi.
Jephthah kiang ah, "Ammon suante ka dou theihna ding un ka heutupen ding un hong om in," achi uhi.
Jephthah in Gilead upate kiang ah, "N'on hua ua, ka pa inn a pan na hon delhkhia uh ahi kei maw? Bang achia na buaitak ua ka kiang a hong na hi ua?" achi hi.

Gilead upate'n Jephthah kiang ah, "Huaiziaktak ahi, tua nang lam ka hong ngat nawn uh. Ammon suante dou dia ka kiang ua na paitheihna ding in; Gilead gam a teng tengtengte tung ah ka heutu ding un na om ding," achi uhi.
Jephthah in Gilead upate kiang ah, "Ammon suante dou dia na hon pikik nawn ua, TOUPA'N amau ahon piakleh na heutu ding un maw ka om ding?" achi hi.
Gilead upate'n Jephthah kiang ah, "Na thu bangbang a ka hih kei uleh i kikal uah hon theihpihpa TOUPA ahi ding,” achi uhi.
Huchi in Jephthah bel Gilead upate kiang ah ahohta a, mite'n heutu ding leh api penpen ding in ana bawlta uhi. Jephthah in Mizpah ah TOUPA ma ah athu teng agenta hi.
Jephthah in Ammon suante kumpipa kiang ah, "Bangchidan a hichibang a ka gam hong dou dia ka kiang a hong pai mawk na hia?" chi in palai asawl hi.

Ammon suante kumpipa'n, "Israelte Aigupta gam a pan ahong pawt lai ua, ka gam ahon laksak ziak uh ahi. Arnon a pan Jabok leh Jordan tan in. Huaiziak in huai gamte lungdam in hon pe nawn mai in," chi in Jephthah palaite ana dawng hi.
Huchi in Jephthah in Ammon suante kumpipa kiang ah palai asawl nawn hi.
Akiang ah, Jephthah in hichi in achi, “Israelte'n Moab gam alaksak kei ua, Ammon suante gam leng alaksak sam kei uh.
Himahleh, Aigupta gam a pan Israelte ahong pawt un gamdai tawn in Tuipi San ahong tung ua, huai a pan Kadesh ah ahong pai uhi.

Israelte'n Edom kumpipa kiang ah, 'Hehpih in na gam ah ka paisuak ding uh,' chi in palai asawl uh. Himahleh Edom kumpipa in ana ngaikhe nuam kei. Huchi mah bang in Moab kumpipa kiang ah asawl nawn a, himahleh pha ana sa kei hi. Huchi in Kadesh ah Israelte a-omta uhi.

Huchi in gamdai ah apaisuak ua, Edom gam leh Moab gam kimvel in apai ua, Moab gam suahlam pang ah apai ua, Arnon lehlam pang ah giahphual asat uhi. Moab gamsung ah alut kei hial uh; Arnon bel Moab gamgi chiang ahi.

Israelte'n Amorte kumpipa Sihon leh Heshbon kumpipa kiang ah palai asawl uhi. Israelte'n akiang ah, ka hong thum uhi, 'Ka mun ua ka paina ding un hehpih in na gam tawn in hon paisuaksak in,' achi uhi.
Himahleh Sihon in Israelte agam a paisuak ding in amuangzou kei. Sihon in ami tengteng akaikhawm a, Jahaz ah akikulh a, Israelte adouta hi.
TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in Sihon leh ami tengteng Israelte khut ah apia a, amaute athat uhi. Huchi in Israelte'n huai gam a om Amorte gam tengteng atangta uhi.
Huchi in Amorte gamgi chiang tengteng Arnon a pan Jabok pha in, gamdai a pan Jordan pha in atangvekta uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in ami Israelte ma ah Amorte ahawlkhia a, bangziak a nang hiai gam luah thei ding na hia?
Na pathian Kemos in nang a tuam dia ahon sehsaksa tang ding hilou na hi maw? Huchi in TOUPA ka Pathian un ka ma ua ahawlkhiakte uh ka tang ding uhi.
Moab kumpipa Zippor tapa Balak sang in na hatzaw a hia? Ama'n Israelte kinakpih in ahihkeileh adou ngei himhim a hia?
Heshbon leh akhotate, Aroer leh akhotate, Arnon gamgi naih khopi tengteng a kum zathum tak aten lai ua, bangziak a nang ana lakik lou nilouh na hia?

Huaiziak in na tung ah thil bangmah ka hihkhial kei. Nangma'n hon dou na tup ziak in ka tung ah thil na hihkhial ahi zaw. TOUPA, Vaihawmpa in tuni in Israel suante leh Ammon suante kal ah thu ngaihtuah hen," achi hi.
Himahleh Ammon suante kumpipa'n Jephthah thukhah ana ngaikhe nuam kei hi.
Huchi in Jephthah tung ah TOUPA kha ahong tung a, Gilead leh Manasseh gam ah apaisuak a, Gilead a Mizpah ah apaisuak a, Gilead gam Mizpah a pan Ammon suante kiang ah apai zel hi.
TOUPA kiang ah Jephthah akichiam a, "Ammon suante ka khut a na hon piakleh,
hichi ahi ding a, Ammon suante a pan galmuang a ka paikik nawn chiang in bangpeuh ka inn kongpi a pan hon dawn masa penpen TOUPA a ahi dia, halmang thillat ding in ka zang ngeingei ding,” achi hi.
Huchi in Jephthah bel Ammon suante dou ding in akuanta hi. TOUPA'N akhut ah amaute apeta hi.
Aroer a pan Minnith pha leh Abel-keramim kal a khopi sawmnih azou vek a, mi tampi athat hi. Huchi in Israel suante'n Ammon suante anuaisiahta uhi.
Jephthah, atenna khua Mizpah a a-inn ah apai a, ngai in, atanu in khuangtate toh lam in ana dawn hi. Ata neihsun ahi a; amah lou tapa hiam tanu dang himhim anei kei hi.
heading: Jephthah Tanu

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, amah amuhtak in apuante abotkek a, "Ehe, ka tanu! N'on niamkiaksak mahmah ve. Hon mangbangsak mite lak a khat na hita. TOUPA ma ah lah ka kam ka na kata ngal a, huai lah zukkik thei ka hita kei," achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Pa aw, TOUPA kiang a thu na chiam tak ahihleh, na kam a thupawt bang in ka tung ah hih in. TOUPA'N lah na melma Ammon suante tung ah na phu ahon laksakta ngal a," achi hi.
Ama'n apa kiang ah, "Hichibang in kei a ding in kihih hen. Kha nih sung ka tang-om dia, tangte ah asuk atou in ka pai dia, ka nungak siangthou hihna ka suun ding, kei leh ka lawmte'n," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Pai ve," achi hi. Huchi in kha nih taam ding in asawlkhia a; apawt a, amah leh alawmte'n tangte ah anungak siangthou hihna ava suun uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, kha nih nung in apa kiang ah ahong kik nawn a, ama'n ana kichiamsa bang in atung ah ahih hi. Atanu nungak siangthou in a-omdenta a, pasal toh alumkhawm ngei kei hi.
Israel tanute'n Gilead mi Jephthah tanu kum teng in ni li sung asuun zel uhi. Hiai Israelte lak ah ngeina in aneita uhi.
